title: feat(console): on a grouped list or a board, the record pane's counter and up/down step within the record's group or lane
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoUkJQrrXvVSkecCi4t5DBVd)_

Fixes #28461

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：分组列表（如按客户分组的联系人列表）和看板里打开记录后，右侧记录面板现在有「1 / 3」计数和 ↓ ↑，只在该记录所在的分组/看板列内切换，计数的提示写明分组名（「Acme Corporation 中第 1 条，共 3 条」）。
- **为什么改**：销售在分组列表或看板里看完一条记录，要关掉面板再点下一行；不分组的列表早就能用 ↓ ↑ / `j` `k` 连续翻看（#27524 Target 7 的遗留项）。
- **风险与回滚**：只加了三个可选的宿主回调（表格、看板、ListView 第二个参数），不传就与原来一致；不分组列表的行为与提示不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx`（分组上报：只报展开且当前页可见的分组）、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewRecordNavigation.ts`（按记录所在分组取兄弟集合与分组名）、`ui/packages/plugin-kanban/src/KanbanImpl.tsx`（看板列上报）。
- **两分钟验证**：HotCRM 打开按客户分组的联系人列表，点 Acme Corporation 下第一位联系人：面板顶栏显示「1 / 3」，悬停提示「Acme Corporation 中第 1 条，共 3 条」，按 ↓ 到同组第二位，同组最后一位的 ↓ 置灰。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`@object-ui/plugin-grid`** — `ObjectGrid` gains an optional host prop `onRowGroupsChange(groups)`: on a grouped grid it reports every open leaf group on the current page of groups, in display order, with its heading (a nested group by its path of headings, joined by ` › `) and the rows drawn under it (a server-grouped group's current page). A collapsed group, or an open one with no rows yet, is left out. Reported on a change of content (keys, headings, row ids), never of identity; an ungrouped grid reports nothing. The band heading and the leaf rows are read through one helper each (`groupHeadingOf`, `leafRowsOf`), so the report and the bands cannot disagree. New type `ObjectGridRowGroup`.
- **`@object-ui/plugin-kanban`** — `ObjectKanban` gains the same optional host prop, relayed to the board (`KanbanBoardProps.onLaneRowsChange`): every open lane in board order with its title and its cards in the order it draws them; on a swimlane board, row by row down the open swimlanes. A collapsed lane is left out. New type `KanbanLaneRows`, exported from the barrel.
- **`@object-ui/plugin-list`** — `ListView` hands the grouped grid and the board that channel (only when a host passed `onRowsChange`) and relays what they report: `onRowsChange(rows, groups)`, the rows end to end and the groups as an optional second argument (`ListViewRowGroup`). A report is held with the view kind that sent it and never relayed once another kind is on screen. A paged ungrouped grid reports exactly as before (no second argument).
- **`@object-ui/app-shell`** — the object page keeps the groups (`listShownRowsOf`) and hands the pane's root the opened record's own group as its sibling set, named by the group (`listSiblingSetOf`; `RecordDrawerLevel.scope`). `RecordStackDrawer` names the root's set by its `scope` before the list's view label; the record page opened from a row (`from` state, or the ↗ way back) carries the same set and name, and its counter names it. `ObjectView.tsx` and `record-top-bar.tsx` are untouched: the tooltip key `detail.recordOfScope` already words Target 7 in all ten packs.

## Tests

- `plugin-grid/src/__tests__/rowGroupsReport-28461.test.tsx` — real `ObjectGrid` grouping on the server: open groups in display order with heading and rows; a group the reader collapses leaves the report; control: an ungrouped grid reports nothing.
- `plugin-kanban/src/ObjectKanban.laneRowsReport-28461.test.tsx` — real board: open lanes in order with their cards; the lost lane (collapsed by its lifecycle kind) is left out until opened.
- `plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.rowGroups-28461.test.tsx` — the relay: a grouped grid and a board each yield rows plus groups; control: an ungrouped grid is not handed the channel and reports rows with no groups.
- `app-shell/src/views/__tests__/recordPaneGroupScope-28461.test.tsx` — the card's Tests: grouped grid counter and group-named tooltip, ↓ to the next row of the same group, the last row of a group has no ↓, the first row of a later group has no ↑; the board the same within a lane; control: an ungrouped list keeps the whole list and the view's name; the object page's root, and the ↗ page's stepper, carry the group's set and name.
- `plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.onRowsChange-26679.test.tsx` — its "no single row order" control moves from a board (which now reports its lanes) to a calendar, which still reports no rows and no groups.

## Acceptance notes

- **Collapsed groups (the order left this open):** the reading the reader sees — shown rows only. A collapsed group or lane draws no rows, so it is not in the set; expanding it brings it back. A record opened by URL inside a collapsed group gets no counter.
- **Server-grouped paging:** a server-grouped group steps through the page of it on screen, not the group's whole count (the other pages are not fetched); the counter says `n / rows on screen`. Paging whole groups (the grouped pager) likewise scopes to the groups on the current page.
- **Swimlane boards:** a lane is the board column; its cards are ordered row by row down the open swimlanes (the order the eye reads the column), and a collapsed swimlane's cards are left out.
- **Nested grouping:** the scope name is the path of headings (`Acme Corporation › Open`), because the leaf heading alone is ambiguous across parents.
- **Neighbours:** `ObjectView.tsx` and `objectViewRecordNavigation.ts` are shared with PR #28477 (#27058) — this PR does not touch `ObjectView.tsx`, and edits only the row-set plumbing in `objectViewRecordNavigation.ts`.
